$comment: Copy to the project as fidelity.config.json. Paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with $ are ignored. Field reference: references/method.md.
$frozenTimeNote: frozenTime only affects the implementation: the prototype has its own fixed demo clock. Mask a clock that still differs.
$tokensCssNote: Optional. With it, every element property that names a token (elements.*.tokens) also reports how far each side is from the token's declared value, per theme.

prototype.$comment: The prototype-showcase file or URL. capture-states adds ?capture=<viewport.capture> and #<hash>&theme=<theme>&motion=reduced.

auth.$comment: method: none | storageState (file you create with --save-auth; never commit it) | manual (Claude in Chrome or DevTools MCP with --print-snippet).
auth.$readySelectorNote: --save-auth saves the session by itself once this selector is visible (a selector that only exists when logged in); no terminal needed. timeoutSeconds (default 600) ends the wait.

implementation.$routesNote: Optional request fixtures: answer matching requests with the prototype's demo data (JSON paths relative to this file).

viewports.$isMobileNote: isMobile with a local HTML file that has no viewport meta renders at 980 px.

masks.$comment: Masked on every state; per-state masks add to these. The union of both sides is painted out before the pixel diff.

states.$comment: One row of the showcase registry/flows: same screen, role and demo data on both sides.

prototype.$hashNote: Parameters beyond screen / role / sheet stay in the hash and reach SHOWCASE.open.

states.reason: The screen is not built yet; reported as pending, not verified.

states.$fullPageNote: fullPage does not capture inner scroll containers: use a scroll step or map an element instead.

elements.$comment: name -> { prototype selector, implementation selector, properties?, tokens?, level?, priority? }. Omitted properties use the default set.
